description: Inventory of every third-party native file this package redistributes: upstream version, licence and SHA-256. tools/Test-NativeManifest.ps1 checks it against the files on disk before release packing.

components.name: rocBLAS
components.license: MIT, plus the third-party notices included in the licence file
components.provenance: The DLL embeds the version string "4.4.1.86c9f06e-dirty": rocBLAS 4.4.1 (the rocBLAS version of ROCm 6.4.2 and 6.4.3) built from ROCm/rocBLAS commit 86c9f06e. It is the rocBLAS shipped by the AMD HIP SDK for Windows, which publishes no per-file hashes, so the SHA-256 is recorded but not compared against an upstream artifact.

components.name: hipBLAS
components.version: unknown: the DLL carries no version resource or version string
components.provenance: Taken from the AMD HIP SDK for Windows 6.4 together with rocblas.dll. The hipBLAS release in ROCm 6.4.x is 2.4.0, but the binary itself does not state its version.

components.name: HIP runtime for Windows (amdhip64)
components.license: Proprietary: the AMD HIP SDK for Windows licence agreement. The Windows HIP runtime is closed source (unlike the MIT-licensed Linux HIP/CLR runtime). Its licence is shown by the HIP SDK installer and is not published as a downloadable text, so its text is not bundled; the package licence file LICENSE.txt names this binary, its version and SHA-256, and where AMD shows the licence.
components.provenance: The DLL's version resource reads ProductName "amdhip64 6.4 AMD-APP.dbg (3652.0)", FileVersion 10.0.3652.0.
